purpose: Advise on studying; teach 教科書/テキスト/用語/沢山/水準/番目/郵便/マガジン

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 教科書だけでなく、テキストも併用しましょう。
lines.en: Use not just the textbook but the text too.
lines.style: guiding teacher offering method, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 専門用語が覚えられなくて。
lines.en: I can’t memorize the technical terms.
lines.style: struggling teen seeking help, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 沢山書いて、手で覚えるのが効果的です。
lines.en: Writing a lot and learning by hand works well.
lines.style: teacher prescribing a technique, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私の水準だと、どの問題から始めれば？
lines.en: At my level, which problems should I start with?
lines.style: teen asking for a starting point

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 教科書の二番目の例題からどうぞ。
lines.en: Start from the textbook’s second example.
lines.style: teacher giving a concrete step, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 補助教材はどうやって入手しますか？
lines.en: How do I get the supplementary materials?
lines.style: teen inquiring practically, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 申し込めば、郵便で送られてきます。
lines.en: If you apply, they’re sent by mail.
lines.style: teacher explaining the process, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生おすすめの学習マガジンも探してみます。
lines.en: I’ll look for the study magazine you recommend too.
lines.style: motivated teen taking initiative, voice clear and distinctly their own
